name: Keep the sketch small
rule: Generate no more than 16 bars and exactly three tracks: Bass, Drums and Pad.

name: Separate harmony and rhythm edits
rule: Harmony suggestions may alter chord pitches or voicings. Rhythm-only suggestions change onset/duration only and preserve note counts, pitches, velocities, onset bars and ordered Pad chord groups.

name: Resolve intentionally
rule: When a progression loops, provide a clear return to tonic or explain the non-tonic loop.

name: Offer alternatives, do not overwrite
rule: Return at least two candidates when practical. Preserve original until explicit apply.

name: Source-aware recommendations
rule: Cite knowledge record IDs. Distinguish sourced theory from project heuristics and generated suggestions.
